title: ACT ON THE TRANSFER OF INHERITED PROPERTY VESTING IN THE STATE
title_original: 국가에 귀속하는 상속재산 이전에 관한 법률
full_text:
Article 1 (Transfer of Property within the Country)
The administrator of inherited property that vests in the State pursuant to Article 1058 (1) of the Civil Act shall, without delay, transfer the administration of that inherited property to the head of the tax office having jurisdiction over the domicile of the deceased.

Article 2 (Transfer of Property outside the Country)
In the case referred to in Article 1, where the domicile of the deceased is in a foreign country, the administration of that inherited property shall, without delay, be transferred to the consul having jurisdiction over that domicile or to a person performing the duties of the consul.

ADDENDA <Act No. 860, December 23, 1961>

① This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
② Imperial Ordinance No. 409 of Dangi year 4232, concerning the delivery of property vesting in the National Treasury where there are no heirs, is hereby repealed.

ADDENDUM <Act No. 9806, October 21, 2009>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
